report: Reviewed the complete claim, sole ordinary parser implementation association, and both ordinary associated test bodies. Requirements are named typed struct fields, retention of names and types in source order, and acceptance of an empty struct. Parser::type_declaration constructs TypeShape::Struct(value_fields()); value_fields requires an identifier and colon, parses the TypeExpr, and pushes each ValueField into a Vec in encounter order. Its initial closing-brace check returns an empty Vec. type_expr preserves named/generic and tuple structure. parses_structs_enums_and_opaque_generics explicitly asserts Pair field names [first, rest] in order, the first field type T, a Signature tuple type and nested generic source span; its named enum payload additionally checks two distinct types through the same value_fields parser. These visible assertions together with the common parser cover retention and would detect dropped/reordered fields or lost tested types. empty_structs_and_variant_payloads_preserve_their_shapes directly asserts TypeShape::Struct(vec![]) after parsing struct Empty {}. Captured parse_body setup and language imports establish these calls use the actual parser; assertions are in the annotated bodies. No TODO/N/A entries or deferred prerequisites exist. Independently verified exact byte equality of current parser.rs, language.rs, and value_types.rs against the historical source snapshots; the prior rationale remains sufficient after reassessing current claim and all evidence. Historical source was used only for equality comparison. Source inspection establishes this assessment; this reviewer ran review start/read and comparison commands, not behavioral tests or a workspace build. Coordinator-reported 321 passing sage-meta tests and passing cargo build are separate baseline execution evidence. Initial process-launch descriptor failures were environmental and did not reproduce a behavior defect. No source edits or additional essential implementation dependencies are required.
